entries.original: Added Claude Haiku 5.5 (`claude-haiku-5-5`), now the default Haiku model on the Anthropic API — 1M context, $0.10/$0.50 per Mtok ($0.50/$2.50 for prompts over 100K)
entries.translated: Added Claude Haiku 5.5 (`claude-haiku-5-5`), now the default Haiku model on the Anthropic API — 1M context, $0.10/$0.50 per Mtok ($0.50/$2.50 for prompts over 100K)

entries.original: Added `agentType` to the `subagentStatusLine` payload, so scripts can tell custom subagent types apart
entries.translated: Added `agentType` to the `subagentStatusLine` payload, so scripts can tell custom subagent types apart

entries.original: Added `isDeferred` to `$.tool.register` for mods: `false` lists the tool's schema in the prompt from the start instead of behind tool search
entries.translated: Added `isDeferred` to `$.tool.register` for mods: `false` lists the tool's schema in the prompt from the start instead of behind tool search

entries.original: Fixed Claude sometimes treating its own last actions before a context compaction as done after it, and retracting or redoing finished work
entries.translated: Fixed Claude sometimes treating its own last actions before a context compaction as done after it, and retracting or redoing finished work

entries.original: Fixed a memory leak where an HTTP MCP connection kept every request it had sent until it closed
entries.translated: Fixed a memory leak where an HTTP MCP connection kept every request it had sent until it closed

entries.original: Fixed a message sent while Claude was working being lost when `←` moved the session to the background; if a queued message can't move, `←` now stays put and says so
entries.translated: Fixed a message sent while Claude was working being lost when `←` moved the session to the background; if a queued message can't move, `←` now stays put and says so

entries.original: Fixed `/model` effort ←/→ wrapping past the highest or lowest level, which could accidentally save Low as a model's default effort
entries.translated: Fixed `/model` effort ←/→ wrapping past the highest or lowest level, which could accidentally save Low as a model's default effort

entries.original: Fixed `/tui` disconnecting Claude in Chrome in a session started with `--chrome`, and ignoring `--no-chrome`
entries.translated: Fixed `/tui` disconnecting Claude in Chrome in a session started with `--chrome`, and ignoring `--no-chrome`

entries.original: Fixed Claude being told to continue or message subagents with `SendMessage` in sessions, including resumed ones, where a host, a permission rule or a `--tools` list removed that tool
entries.translated: Fixed Claude being told to continue or message subagents with `SendMessage` in sessions, including resumed ones, where a host, a permission rule or a `--tools` list removed that tool

entries.original: Fixed subagents and `--agent` sessions being told a built-in tool was disabled for the whole session when only their own tool list left it out

entries.original: Fixed a claude.ai-synced skill's edited description sometimes not reaching the model until a new conversation or `/clear`
entries.translated: Fixed a claude.ai-synced skill's edited description sometimes not reaching the model until a new conversation or `/clear`

entries.translated: Fixed the `/ultrareview` upload on Linux wrongly refusing some repositories, such as one inside another checkout, over a settings file that "could not be parsed" while a sandboxed command was running

entries.translated: Fixed replies in very long Remote Control and cloud sessions that could still appear a block at a time instead of streaming in

entries.translated: Fixed `←` backgrounding a session after 10 seconds while the prompt held unsent text (it now cancels the move) or a question was waiting for your answer

entries.translated: Improved startup for Team and Enterprise organizations: policy and managed settings are fetched earlier, and a stalled request is retried after 3 seconds
